solution:
numbers = [-5, 2, -1, 8, 0, -3, 10]
words = ["cat", "elephant", "dog", "butterfly", "ox"]
mixed_data = ["25", "invalid", 42, "17", "corrupted", 100]

# 1. Filter positive numbers:
positive = [num for num in numbers if num > 0]

# 2. Label numbers as even/odd:
labels = ["even" if num % 2 == 0 else "odd" for num in numbers]

# 3. Filter long words:
long_words = [word for word in words if len(word) > 3]

# 4. Square positives, zero negatives:
transformed = [num**2 if num > 0 else 0 for num in numbers]

# 5. Extract valid numbers from mixed data:
valid_numbers = [int(item) if isinstance(item, str) else item for item in mixed_data if isinstance(item, int) or (isinstance(item, str) and item.isdigit())]
hints: Use [item for item in iterable if condition] for filtering
Use [true_expr if condition else false_expr for item] for conditional transformation
For mixed data, use isinstance() to check types
Use str.isdigit() to check if a string represents a number
